critical_code_review_comments: get_ms_graph_token() imports msal inside function on every call - fine for correctness but slight overhead per request; consider module-level import

fetch_outlook_emails uses synchronous requests inside run_in_executor - acceptable, but token is fetched on every /inbox call (no caching). MSAL result contains 'expires_in'; consider caching token to avoid latency and rate limits
download_inbox_attachment: no filename sanitization for Content-Disposition (name comes from Graph API so low risk, but could break with special chars/newlines)
Missing data-testid attributes on email cards and attachment download buttons in AdminInbox.js - would help future automated tests
